subject: planner: Include DNF in compareCandidates (#63085)
summary: Reviewed commit 8c65f823a92d8fe327d97e93207798b8d936e2f8 relative to its first parent (planner-only focus). Change integrates DNF-aware equal/IN predicate coverage into skyline pruning path comparison via `compareEqOrIn`/`equalPredicateCount`, with associated pruning/test updates. No remaining Blocker/High planner correctness/semantics issues found; one potential heuristic pitfall around DNF full-match detection and `hasOnlyEqualPredicatesInDNF` handling was adjusted later on upstream/master (e.g. 98a285f885, 9c27eaef72), so it is not a remaining issue.
